cohort: The study included 254 pregnant women in their second trimester with singleton pregnancy who attended an antenatal clinic in Jharkhand, India.
finding: Anti-TPO antibody positivity was significantly related to miscarriage and anemia, while preterm delivery, pre-eclampsia, and low birth weight were higher in anti-TPO antibody-positive patients but without statistical significance.
mod_finding: Mode of birth did not significantly differ between anti-TPO antibody positive and negative groups (p=0.549).
gest_age: second trimester (for cohort inclusion), preterm delivery (as an outcome)
